_what: Rule 4b applied to the readings of every record of rounds 5 to 8 (decision of the Claude analysis session, 24 October 2026; rules.md, rule 4b). Rule 4b: where rule 1's control does not tie, a record leaves the primary when (i) both readings report that the year t table prints, for an underwriting year u <= t-2, cumulative paid lower than the year t-1 report printed for the same year, by more than the exchange rate explains and with no explanation in either filing; (ii) the year t table fails the year's accounts by more than 10% (rule 1's test); and (iii) no base gives a figure that reconciles (rule 3 fails).
_method: scan_rule_4b.py reads every reading of the 83 records (round5/readings/*.json, round8/readings/Z7.json, Z8.json) three ways: a structural pass that takes every pair of paid cells a reading quotes against each other ('A-B=C', 'A vs B', 'A against B', 'A -> B', 'from A to B', 'A then B', 'prints B for the same', 'below B') with the later below the earlier, inside a passage about paid or payments that is not a table-against-accounts comparison; and two text passes (narrow and loose) for a paid figure near a word of decrease. Every record any pass flags is answered under 'read' against the precondition and conditions (i) to (iii), with the structural pairs it was flagged on ('structural_hits', reader by reader) and, where (i) holds on a reading, the cells. Records the review of the fixes named (435/2016, 1218/2016, 1084/2016) and those review 8 named (2488/2016, 382/2021, 1967/2017) are answered too. Every other record is under 'no_fall_reported': no reading quotes a falling pair of paid cells and no passage reports one, so condition (i) fails. (ii) is read incurred first (24 October 2026): the implied gross incurred test wherever the table gives one, the paid test only where it gives none.
